stories_selected.title: Security Updates for SQL Server 2025 and 2022 (CVE-2026-66813)
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Microsoft released security updates for SQL Server 2025 RTM CU10, SQL Server 2025 RTM GDR, SQL Server 2022 RTM CU27, and SQL Server 2022 RTM GDR, all addressing CVE-2026-66813, a Denial of Service vulnerability — DBAs should evaluate and apply the appropriate KB (5129299, 5132748, 5129300, or 5132747) based on their installed version and patch track.

stories_selected.title: Help prevent out-of-memory restarts on Aurora MySQL 8.4
stories_selected.dba_relevance: AWS published guidance on diagnosing and preventing OOM-triggered instance restarts on Aurora MySQL 8.4 — DBAs on that version should review the recommended configuration and monitoring approaches to reduce unplanned availability events.

stories_selected.title: Amazon Aurora and RDS now support Graviton5-based R9g database instances
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Graviton5-based R9g instances are now available for Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL and MySQL) and RDS, offering a new hardware tier for capacity planning and instance type migrations — DBAs should evaluate R9g as a candidate for their next instance resize or rightsizing review.

stories_selected.title: Aurora PostgreSQL with express configuration now supported in CloudFormation
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Aurora PostgreSQL clusters using the express configuration can now be provisioned and managed via AWS CloudFormation, enabling DBREs to include express-tier Aurora PostgreSQL in infrastructure-as-code pipelines and automated environment builds.
